champion.label: V1
champion.note: EDGEDESK FAIR is the governance champion’s number. A person promotes a challenger (football/cfb_lab/governance.js promote); this build then follows it.

decision.calibrated_ev_note: Under the frozen decision calibration (cfb_decision_calibration_v1, for edgedesk_cfb_v2.1.0) the calibrated EV never reaches the policy minimum: its highest value is -3.2% at any price, so no quote can be a certified bet today.

operations.rule: the worst section decides; UNKNOWN is never reported as OK

sources.what: the EdgeDesk Read: price-specific reads, frozen read snapshots and their grades (append-only)
the EdgeDesk EV engine: calibrated, robust, price-specific EV; frozen EV snapshots and their grades (append-only)

rule: One bettor-facing decision per game from lib/edgedesk_decision.js, on the same model, quotes and evaluation as the quote-level EV. Research status is never a decision; a BET needs every gate, a fresh two-sided quote and a calibrated EV above the action floor.

validation.note: The thresholds and stake tiers are conservative, configurable defaults, not empirically validated yet; the per-tier record below is how they will be.

unit.text: Set a bankroll or a unit to see dollar amounts.
